traits.name: Hivemind
traits.text:
All wasps within 10 miles of their queen
are in constant communication via a telepathic
bond.

traits.name: Hive Tactics
traits.text:
The wasp has advantage on an attack
roll against a creature if at least one of the wasp’s
allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally
isn’t incapacitated.

actions.name: Sting
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5ft.,
one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 4 (1d8)
poison damage.
